items.q: Are your homes listed in public?
items.a: Most are not. Homes are shown privately to buyers whose search matches, and some are shared only by introduction.

items.q: How do I arrange a viewing?
items.a: Send a request through the form below. Your adviser will call you, confirm a time, and meet you at the residence.

items.q: Can I keep my search private?
items.a: Yes. Your name and details are shared with no one without your word, and viewings are arranged one buyer at a time.

items.q: Do you work with buyers from abroad?
items.a: Yes. We arrange video walkthroughs first, then a shortlist of viewings for your visit, with a lawyer you choose reviewing the papers.
Fees depend on the service and the home, and they are agreed in writing before any viewing. An introductory conversation is free.

items.q: Can you help sell my home privately?
items.a: Yes. We present the home discreetly to matched buyers, manage the viewings, and handle the negotiation and papers.
